basic_details.short_information: The Office of the Mission Director, National Health Mission (NHM), Assam, has released an advertisement (No. NHM-31013(11)/5/2025-HRD-NHM, ECF: 678091, dated 29.07.2026) inviting online applications for engagement of Staff Nurses on contractual basis, for candidates willing to work in mission mode. This NHM Assam Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 drive covers 2204 posts across zones in Assam.

content_sections.heading: NHM Assam Staff Nurse Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed a B.Sc. Nursing or GNM Course from any nursing school/institution recognized by the Indian Nursing Council, and must be registered with the Assam Nurses' Midwives' and Health Visitors' Council. The upper age limit is 40 years, as on 01.01.2026, with the following category-wise relaxation and maximum age. Age relaxation applied: SC/ST candidates get 5 years, OBC/MOBC candidates get 3 years, and PWD candidates get 10 years over the base limit of 40 years. The age of candidates will be calculated based on the Matriculation/HSLC Admit Card or Pass Certificate issued by a recognized Board/Council - no other document will be accepted for this purpose.

content_sections.heading: NHM Assam Staff Nurse Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is required to be paid for NHM Assam Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026.

content_sections.heading: NHM Assam Staff Nurse Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a remuneration of ₹20,000 per month.

content_sections.heading: NHM Assam Staff Nurse Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process will be notified separately on the official website of the Directorate of National Health Mission, Assam (nhm.assam.gov.in), in due course of time, along with the list of provisionally shortlisted candidates. Candidates are advised to check the website regularly, as no separate individual call letter will be sent for interview or selection test.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHM Assam Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official NHM Assam website at https://nhm.assam.gov.in. Open the online application form for Staff Nurse engagement. Fill in the required details and indicate a zone-wise preference if desired. Upload the supporting documents, including educational qualification, experience, and other relevant documents. Submit the application between 01.08.2026 and 15.08.2026, before 11:59 PM on the last date.

content_sections.heading: NHM Assam Staff Nurse Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will be rejected without any prior information to the candidate. Claims for any correction will not be entertained after the online application has been submitted. Candidates must upload all supporting documents (educational qualification, experience, and others) along with the application. The number of vacancies may vary at the time of recruitment. Detailed terms & conditions and other recruitment criteria will be published on the official website in due course - candidates should check nhm.assam.gov.in regularly.

faq.question: Q1. What is NHM Assam Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an advertisement by the Office of the Mission Director, National Health Mission (NHM), Assam, for engagement of Staff Nurses on contractual basis in mission mode, dated 29.07.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NHM Assam Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2,204 Staff Nurse posts, though the notification states the number of vacancies may vary at the time of recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NHM Assam Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 15.08.2026, till 11:59 PM (applications opened on 01.08.2026).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for NHM Assam Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A B.Sc. Nursing or GNM Course passed from an Indian Nursing Council-recognized institution, with registration with the Assam Nurses' Midwives' and Health Visitors' Council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NHM Assam Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Up to 40 years as on 01.01.2026 for the Open/UR category, with relaxation up to 43 years for OBC/MOBC, 45 years for SC/ST(P)/ST(H), and 50 years for PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NHM Assam Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, no application fee is required to be paid.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for NHM Assam Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the NHM Assam website, https://nhm.assam.gov.in, between 01.08.2026 and 15.08.2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NHM Assam Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will be notified separately on the official website, along with a list of provisionally shortlisted candidates; no individual call letter will be sent.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for NHM Assam Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The remuneration is ₹20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates choose their preferred posting zone?
faq.answer: Yes, zone-wise preference may be indicated among the five zones - Barak Valley, Central Assam, Lower Assam, North Assam, and Upper Assam - though final posting is subject to the recruitment process.
